faq.h1: Clear answers before the first conversation.
faq.body: Find practical answers about working with Real Result.

faqs.question: Is Real Result a marketing company or a software company?
faqs.answer: Real Result is a marketing company. Website, app, and software development are supporting services for customer experiences, campaigns, and business operations.

faqs.question: What marketing services does Real Result offer?
faqs.answer: Services include strategy, SEO, AI search optimization, paid advertising, social media, content, branding, lead generation, conversion optimization, email, and customer communication.

faqs.question: Which calling and messaging services are available?
faqs.answer: Bulk voice calls, real-time AI calling, bulk SMS, RCS business messaging, and WhatsApp marketing and messaging.

faqs.question: How do bulk voice calls differ from AI calling?
faqs.answer: Bulk voice campaigns play a recorded message. Real-time AI calling listens and responds during a two-way conversation.

faqs.question: Can I use one service?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can discuss a focused campaign, an individual project, or connected services around one goal.

faqs.question: What affects pricing?
faqs.answer: Scope, complexity, campaign volume, destination, tools, and support affect the quote. Agency fees and third-party charges are identified in the proposal.

faqs.question: Can you work with our existing tools?
faqs.answer: Yes. We assess current websites, campaigns, accounts, and systems before defining what to keep, connect, or change.

faqs.question: How quickly can work start?
faqs.answer: Timing depends on the agreed scope, access, assets, account readiness, and any provider approvals. We discuss milestones before work begins.

faqs.question: Can you guarantee sales or AI-search recommendations?
faqs.answer: No. We agree on goals and measures, but customer decisions and search-system selections are outside our control.

faqs.question: Who owns the accounts, code, and creative?
faqs.answer: Ownership, licences, access, and handover are specified in the agreement.

insightArticle.h1: Your next enquiry is only the beginning.
insightArticle.introduction: Someone has found you and filled in the form. What happens next deserves as much attention as the campaign that brought them there.

sections.title: WHERE DOES THE ENQUIRY GO?
sections.body: Does it reach the right person, or wait in a shared inbox? Give each enquiry a clear owner and make its status visible.

sections.title: WHAT DOES THE CUSTOMER SEE?
sections.body: After submitting the form, does the visitor know it worked? Confirm receipt and explain the next step in plain language.

sections.title: WHAT DOES YOUR TEAM KNOW?
sections.body: Can they see what the person asked about and where the enquiry came from? Useful context makes the first conversation easier to prepare for.

sections.title: WHAT HAPPENS IF THEY ARE NOT READY?
sections.body: Some people need more information or more time. Decide what helpful follow-up looks like and respect their communication preferences.

sections.title: WHAT CAN YOU LEARN FROM THE OUTCOME?
sections.body: Connect the enquiry with its eventual status. Was it suitable? Did a conversation happen? What question or obstacle kept coming up?

nextStep.title: YOUR NEXT STEP
nextStep.body: Choose one recent enquiry and follow its journey from the form to the outcome. Note where a person had to chase, guess, or repeat information. That is a useful place to investigate.

finalContact.body: We can help you connect marketing, enquiry capture, and the workflow that comes next.
